# AI

Fields and actions filled by a model, the assistant beside the admin, and MCP.

- [AI fields](../reference/ai.md#ai-fields): A model fills a field from a prompt that uses the record's other fields, after each change.
- [AI actions](../reference/ai.md#ai-actions): A button asks a model to write a field now, such as a suggested priority or a translation.
- [Assistant](../reference/assistant.md): A chat beside the admin that answers questions about the app, reads its data and proposes changes for approval.
- [Choice of model](../reference/assistant.md#which-backend): The assistant runs on OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, also a local one.
- [Assistant tools](../reference/assistant.md#the-apps-own-tools): Your own tools for the assistant, acting on records as the user.
- [MCP server](../reference/mcp.md#the-tools): AI clients connect to the app over MCP as the signed-in person, and list, find and read records within that person's access, soft-deleted ones too when asked.
- [MCP writes](../reference/mcp.md#writes): When turned on, for every resource or only those you list, AI clients create, update and delete records after the person approves each write.
- [MCP writes without approval](../reference/mcp.md#writes-without-approval): Roles you name, such as service accounts, write over MCP without being asked to approve each write; everyone else is still asked.
- [Connected apps](../reference/auth.md#oauth-for-mcp-clients): People allow an AI client to sign in, and disconnect it later.
